ludlow-garage.mobility.1: The main (east) entrance to the Ludlow Garage has one step. We also have an entrance on the west side of the restaurant which is in the hallway to Ace Hardware in the same building that has no steps.
ludlow-garage.mobility.2: We have a lift to get from the first floor (restaurant) to the lower level (venue) and back. The lift is located right next to the steps. It is designed for self-use but if you would like some help, we will be more than happy to lend a hand. Just ask!
ludlow-garage.chronic.1: We do have ADA restrooms for men & women.
ludlow-garage.cognitive.1: Wheelchair accessible tickets are available for sale on TicketMaster as they last.
ludlow-garage.cognitive.2: General Admission shows have no guarantee of seating.
The Ludlow Garage does not have a parking lot. Please see our website for the closest pay lots.
ludlow-garage.cognitive.3: No backpacks of any kind are permitted. Permitted Bags Clear bags that do not exceed 12" x 12" x 6" . Small clutch bags that do not exceed 6" x 9" - these do not need to be clear. Entry Inspection All bags will be inspected upon entry. For everyone's safety, only bags that meet the above guidelines will be permitted inside the venue. Guests who arrive with non-compliant bags will be asked to return them to their vehicles or dispose of them before entering.
All guests entering the venue are subject to a metal-detector screening by way of a magnetometer, visual inspection, and/or bag inspection conducted by venue security personnel.
ludlow-garage.sensory.1: Hearing protection: Concerts can be loud. We strongly recommend appropriate hearing protection for young children.
miami-whitewater-forest.mobility.2: Visitors can now use a Zero G-Chair Swing at Winton Woods, Sharon Woods, Lake Isabella, Woodland Mound, Miami Whitewater Forest, Shawnee Lookout and Embshoff Woods.

Great Parks has eight Solo Rider golf carts available at the following golf courses: Meadow Links & Golf Academy, The Mill Course, Little Miami Golf Center, Miami Whitewater Forest Golf Course and The Vineyard Golf Course. A Solo Rider cart can be reserved by calling the individual course.
miami-whitewater-forest.mobility.3: Amenities 0.6 mile Nature Trail Easy/Moderate Not Accessible
miami-whitewater-forest.mobility.5: The campus features a greenhouse, seed processing facility, program and event venue, seed production rows and a paved connection to the Shaker Trace Outer Loop Trail.
miami-whitewater-forest.cognitive.2: A valid Motor Vehicle Permit is required to enter the parks.
miami-whitewater-forest.chronic.1: The Miami Whitewater Forest Harbor offers fishing and boating access, a snack bar with outdoor seating, trail access and more.
